title: Arc 2: bytes_eq content pins — insert_str/backspace exact prefix/run/suffix postconditions + render_frame payload pin (review items 2+3)

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content:
PLAN + BLOCKER (honest STOP per O-5 + manifest lowerer-limitation clause).

PLAN as designed:
- (a) recursive spec fn bytes_eq(a,b,ai,bi,n)->bool, dec n, byte_at reads — VERIFIED to lower + certify L3 in isolation (probe: bytes_eq L3, 11 obligations discharged).
- (b) insert_str unchanged-prefix/inserted-run/shifted-suffix bytes_eq pins.
- (c) backspace prefix/shifted-suffix bytes_eq pins.
- (d) render_frame payload bytes_eq pin at the post-clear offset.

BLOCKER (lowerer limitation, NOT patchable within this manifest):
emit_string_wrapper (thermite-lower/src/lower.rs) emits slice() and concat() with LENGTH-ONLY ensures:
  concat: ens result.data.len() == self.data.len() + b.data.len()   (NO byte-content)
  slice : ens result.data.len() == hi - lo                          (NO byte-content)
No byte-content postcondition (no result.data@ == self.data@.subrange(lo,hi) for slice; no result.data@ == self.data@ + b.data@ for concat). insert_str/backspace/render_frame ALL build their result solely via slice+concat, so verus knows the result LENGTH but not its BYTES — any bytes_eq claim over a sliced/concatenated result is UNPROVABLE at L3.

PROOF (minimal counterexample claim):
  fn slice_id(a:&String)->String req a.len()<=900_000 ens result.len()==a.len() ens bytes_eq(&result,a,0,0,a.len()) { a.slice(0,a.len()) }
  -> bytes_eq L3, slice_id L0 (postcondition not satisfied). Even a FULL-LENGTH slice's bytes cannot be proven equal to the source.

FIX (out of scope): strengthen slice/concat ensures with the subrange/append byte-content relation (the wrapper already computes subrange invariants internally — trim's ens exposes result.data@ == self.data@.subrange(lo,hi)). That edit lives in thermite-lower/src/lower.rs::emit_string_wrapper, EXPLICITLY out of this manifest's scope.

Per O-5: NOT weakening pins to vacuity, NOT patching the toolchain. STOP + report. Prerequisite: a thermite-lower builder issue adding byte-content (subrange/append) ensures to TString::slice/concat must land FIRST. No edits to editor.th/editor_runs.rs this dispatch (baseline already kills F-IDENT via length pins: insert_str 4/4, backspace 6/6, render_frame 2/2, all L3 — verified live).

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content:
ARC-2 (#276) — HONEST STOP per O-5 + R-DEFER-9. A SECOND, DISTINCT blocker, AFTER the #277 prerequisite landed cleanly.

PLAN as designed (manifest a-d):
- (a) spec fn bytes_eq(a,b,ai,bi,n)->bool, dec n, byte_at reads — recursive: n==0 ? true : a.byte_at(ai)==b.byte_at(bi) && bytes_eq(a,b,ai+1,bi+1,n-1). VERIFIED L3 in isolation (11 obligations discharged, live verus).
- (b) insert_str: unchanged-prefix bytes_eq(&result.text,&b.text,0,0,cursor); inserted-run bytes_eq(&result.text,&ins,cursor,0,ins.len()); shifted-suffix bytes_eq(&result.text,&b.text,cursor+ins.len(),cursor,text.len()-cursor).
- (c) backspace: unchanged-prefix bytes_eq(&result.text,&b.text,0,0,cursor-1); shifted-suffix.
- (d) render_frame payload bytes_eq(&result,&b.text,8,0,b.text.len()) at the post-clear offset.

#277 LANDED CLEANLY (verified): slice now ens result.data@ == self.data@.subrange(lo,hi); concat now ens result.data@ == self.data@ + b.data@. The prior #276 blocker (length-only ens) is GONE.

NEW BLOCKER (toolchain limitation, NOT patchable within this manifest — distinct from the prior STOP):
Even WITH the subrange/append byte-content ens, NO content pin discharges. EVERY one fails L0 "postcondition not satisfied" at real verus, characterized one conjunct at a time:
  - insert_str unchanged-PREFIX ALONE          -> L0 FAIL
  - insert_str inserted-RUN ALONE              -> L0 FAIL
  - backspace unchanged-PREFIX ALONE           -> L0 FAIL
  - render payload (clear.concat(body)) ALONE  -> L0 FAIL
  - minimal slice_id(a)=a.slice(0,a.len()) ens bytes_eq(&result,a,0,0,a.len()) -> L0 FAIL (both recursion directions: low-peel and high-peel).
bytes_eq itself + Buffer stay L3 throughout.

ROOT CAUSE (precise): verus has result.text.data@ == (head@ + ins@) + tail@ and head@ == b.text@.subrange(0,cursor), and bytes_eq walks spec_byte_at = data@[i] index-by-index. Bridging the subrange/append FACT to the RECURSIVE bytes_eq for SYMBOLIC n needs an INDUCTION lemma (subrange/append-equality => recursive byte-wise equality). Verus does NOT auto-induct on a recursive spec fn named in a postcondition for symbolic n.

WHY UN-FIXABLE IN THIS MANIFEST (two independent walls):
  1. The .th SURFACE HAS NO proof fn / lemma (thermite-syntax: only fn / spec fn; #[boundary]/#[slag] reject on spec fn). I cannot write the inductive bridge in editor.th.
  2. There is NO general forall quantifier in the surface (only ADT combinator forms forall_in/sorted — NOT a byte-range quantifier), so a quantified (non-recursive) bytes-equality predicate is ALSO inexpressible.
  3. The lowerer's shape-keyed proof-aid (push_lemma_for / accumulator_aid, thermite-lower/src/lower.rs) emits induction lemmas ONLY for the accumulator-FOLD-in-a-LOOP shape. insert_str/backspace/render bodies are straight-line slice+concat (no loop), so NO aid fires; and no generic subrange=>recursive-bytewise lemma is emitted for an arbitrary boolean recursive spec fn.

FIX (OUT OF SCOPE, prereq for a future Arc-2): thermite-lower must auto-emit (shape-keyed, R-CHAR-3) a generic induction lemma
  proof fn lemma_bytes_eq_subrange(...) ensures (a.subrange(ai,ai+n) == b.subrange(bi,bi+n)) ==> bytes_eq(a,b,ai,bi,n)
  (by induction on n, =~= extensionality, mirroring lemma_count_push / lemma_parse_push) AND cite it from a fn whose body builds the result via slice/concat and whose ens names bytes_eq. That edit lives in thermite-lower/src/lower.rs — EXPLICITLY outside this manifest (editor.th / editor_runs.rs only).

PER O-5 / R-DEFER-9: NOT weakening pins to vacuity, NOT substituting a length-only pin and calling it content, NOT patching the toolchain. STOP + report.

BASELINE (O-2/O-3, before==after; NO edit committed): current editor.th certifies L3 across the board — insert_str 4/4, backspace 6/6, render_frame 2/2 (length pins already kill F-IDENT). bytes_eq absent (not added — would regress to L0 without the lemma). NO new survivors, NO regression.

NO commit. Manifest files (examples/editor/editor.th, forge/tests/editor_runs.rs) UNTOUCHED. Prereq blocker: a thermite-lower builder issue adding the bytes_eq-from-subrange induction lemma (auto-emitted, shape-keyed, no surface proof fn) must land FIRST.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content:
ARC-2 final (#276) — HONEST STOP per O-5 + R-DEFER-9. A THIRD, DISTINCT blocker, surfacing only at the editor's REAL bodies (the C8 lemmas + #277/#278 plumbing all landed and work — the demo certifies).

PLAN as designed (manifest a-d), pin shapes verbatim from the manifest / 07-strings.md REQ-18:
- (a) insert_str: ens bytes_eq(&result.text,&b.text,0,0,b.cursor) | bytes_eq(&result.text,&ins,b.cursor,0,ins.len()) | bytes_eq(&result.text,&b.text,b.cursor+ins.len(),b.cursor,b.text.len()-b.cursor).
- (b) backspace: prefix (0..cursor-1) + shifted suffix.
- (c) render_frame: payload bytes_eq(&result,&b.text,8,0,b.text.len()) at the post-clear offset (clear.len()==8).

VERIFIED WORKING (#278 pipeline is real): conformance/bytes_eq_demo.th certifies through the live forge -> slice_id L3 (2/2), insert_str L3 (3/3). emit_bytes_eq_defs emits the Seq<u8> def + the four prove-once lemmas + the contract-keyed proof{lemma_bytes_eq_bridge();} body-start citation. So #277 (slice/concat byte-content ens) AND #278 (bytes_eq built-in + bridge) are genuinely landed.

NEW BLOCKER (toolchain limitation, NOT patchable within this manifest — distinct from both prior STOPs; NOT an induction/lemma gap this time, a LOWERING type-mismatch gap):
thermite-lower::lower_spec_arg (thermite-lower/src/lower.rs, lines ~7633-7643) lowers a bytes_eq String OPERAND that is a single-segment path (&ins, &result, &a) correctly to <name>.data@ (the Seq<u8> byte view). But a String operand that is a FIELD ACCESS (&result.text, &b.text — Expr::Ref{ expr: Expr::Field{..} }, NOT Expr::Path) is NOT matched by the &-stripping byteview rule (it requires Expr::Path with segs.len()==1), so it falls through to lower_expr and emits &result.text / &b.text — a &TString reference — against bytes_eq's a: Seq<u8>, b: Seq<u8> signature. Real verus: E0308 'expected Seq<u8>, found &TString' at EVERY such conjunct. insert_str drops L3 -> L0.

MINIMAL REPRO (verus-confirmed E0308): a Buffer-wrapped result with ONE pin
  struct Buf { text: String, cursor: u64 } inv cursor <= text.len() && text.len() <= 1_000_000
  fn ins(b: Buf, s: String) -> Buf req ... ens bytes_eq(&result.text, &b.text, 0, 0, b.cursor) { ... head.concat(s).concat(tail) ... }
emits __thermite_bytes_eq(&result.text, &b.text, 0 as int, ...) -> E0308. The C8 demo never tripped this because bytes_eq_demo.th uses ONLY flat String params / the whole result (&text/&ins/&a/&result, all single-segment paths); the editor pins MUST name result.text / b.text (the Buffer's text field), which are field accesses — unavoidable, the editor wraps its String in a Buffer ADT and the manifest pin shapes (REQ-18 lines 666-672) spell &result.text / &b.text verbatim.

WHY UN-FIXABLE IN THIS MANIFEST: the fix is in thermite-lower/src/lower.rs::lower_spec_arg — extend the byteview ref-strip rule to cover Expr::Field String operands (both the &result.text Ref-of-Field form and a bare result.text Field form), emitting <field-access>.data@ when the field's type is String and the callee takes the byte view. EXPLICITLY outside this manifest (editor.th / editor_runs.rs only). Flattening the editor's Buffer to avoid the field access is out of scope and would gut the editor's design; weakening the pins to length-only is the cheat O-5/R-DEFER-9 forbid.

PER O-5 / R-DEFER-9: NOT weakening pins to vacuity, NOT flattening the editor, NOT patching the toolchain outside the manifest. STOP + report.

BASELINE (O-2/O-3, before==after; NO edit committed): editor.th certifies L3 across the board — insert_str 4/4, backspace 6/6, render_frame 2/2 (length pins already kill F-IDENT). NO new survivors, NO regression. Manifest files UNTOUCHED. Prereq: a thermite-lower builder issue extending lower_spec_arg's byteview rule to field-access String operands must land FIRST.
